notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 91–382, Aug. 18, 1970, 84 Stat. 810, related to reimbursement to Senators and President of Senate of official telephone and telegraph communications charges incurred by them or on their behalf out of contingent fund of Senate up to a maximum of $150 per annum.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Pub. L. 92–342 provided that the repeal is effective July 1, 1972.
